caption:
ATO update: you can keep paying tax by credit card until 30 June 2027.

The ATO had announced it would stop accepting credit card payments after 30 November 2026. On 9 October 2026 it extended the transition period: credit card payments for tax obligations continue until 30 June 2027.

What it means for a small business:
- If you pay BAS or income tax by card, nothing changes this month.
- If you're on an ATO payment plan linked to a credit card, you'll need to move it to another payment method before the cut-off, or payments will fail and the plan can default.
- Other payment methods stay available (see "how to pay" on ato.gov.au).

Worth a note in the calendar for mid-2027.
